sources.excerpt: SKU: PWS9786431256 Category: Discounted items $208.99 $104.50 In stock Vox 7001 Distortion 1980 quantity Add to cart Description The Vox Model 7001 (sometimes labeled Model 9001) Distortion Pedal was introduced in the 1981 "Vox: Born Out of Rock" product catalogand produced for Vox by Guyatone of Japan. The trapezoidal shape of the die cast aluminum case allowed several Vox 7000 series to form a curved array on the floor. The pedal operated on either a 9 volt battery or an optional 9 VDC external power supply. The pedal featured two rotary controls: Output and Distortion.
